# freshdesk_canned_response_folders (Data Source)

Every canned response folder on the helpdesk.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "freshdesk_canned_response_folders" "example" {}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Read-Only

- `canned_response_folders` (Attributes List) Every canned response folder the API returned. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--canned_response_folders))
- `id` (String) Placeholder identifier for the data source. Always `canned_response_folders`.

<a id="nestedatt--canned_response_folders"></a>
### Nested Schema for `canned_response_folders`

Read-Only:

- `created_at` (String) When the folder was created (RFC 3339).
- `id` (String) Numeric identifier of the canned response folder.
- `name` (String) Name of the folder.
- `personal` (Boolean) Whether this is an agent's private folder.
- `responses_count` (Number) Number of canned responses in the folder.
- `updated_at` (String) When the folder was last changed (RFC 3339).
